objective: Correct the integrated Windows mGBA supervisor and staged-ROM boundary using the independent correctness/security findings, without weakening first-instruction Job containment or overstating platform guarantees.
closed_decisions: Keep windows-spawn =0.1.0 and its creation-time PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST plus kill-on-close Jobs. Do not fall back to PID-only termination or direct std/tokio mGBA spawn on Windows.
Make MgbaSupervisor stop idempotent with a cached typed outcome. Repeated SupervisedChildren stop after lifecycle compensation must not return BrokenPipe or skip lease release.

Make repeated cancellation of MgbaSupervisor::wait harmless: closed wait replies must never fill the bounded pending queue or turn routine heartbeat/select cancellation into a process failure. Add a regression exceeding queue capacity.

The seven-argument owned-ROM launch must revalidate the held ROM identity immediately before CreateProcess, just like the one-argument form, and use the bound canonical ROM path as argv. Hold a GENERIC_READ-only deny-write/delete ROM integrity guard through the full mGBA lifetime. It must be compatible with official mGBA's read-only CRT open. Preserve the separately documented same-user cleanup race rather than claiming handle-atomic deletion.

Replace captured anonymous probe pipes and blocking reader threads with bounded temporary-file capture (or an equally robust safe-Rust mechanism) so windows-spawn's documented reverse handle-inheritance race cannot retain a writer and hang reader joins. Enforce bounded file size while polling and bounded reads afterward.

Probe cleanup failure outranks timeout/output/version failure and maps to CompatibilityError::MgbaCleanup. Use one explicit absolute final cleanup deadline for post-spawn probe operation; never return an ordinary timeout when Job termination is unconfirmed.

Do not claim that safe Rust can cancel a synchronous stalled CreateProcessW call or that root-process reaping proves a terminated Job has zero active descendants. Preserve these as explicit residual limitations; do not detach supervisor or reader threads.

Containment fixtures must wait for an immediate descendant-started handshake before triggering timeout/drop/cancellation/stop and must quote paths with spaces. Add successful real official-mGBA gameplay-open evidence through the production ROM guard/spawn path when COOP_REAL_MGBA and COOP_REAL_ROM are supplied; keep it opt-in for ordinary CI.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit sidecar/session/main lifecycle, manifest/generator/schema consumers, docs, cloud/server/protocol/save/ROM, Cargo manifests, or orchestration artifacts.
Do not add unsafe Rust, allow attributes, direct Win32 FFI, shell-based production launch, unbounded output storage, detached threads, or a fallback that executes an unverified/uncontained binary.
Do not weaken exact executable digest/version/platform validation, ROM hash validation, environment clearing, Job kill-on-close, checkpoint semantics, lease ordering, or cleanup fail-closed behavior.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, create/remove worktrees, or revert another worker's changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Repeated stop and more than the wait-command capacity of cancelled waits remain successful and leak-free under Windows regressions.

Both mGBA argv forms revalidate the exact held ROM immediately before contained spawn; the owned form uses canonical argv and its integrity guard permits the pinned real mGBA to open the ROM while denying mutation/replacement for the process lifetime.

Probe capture has no blocking pipe-reader thread lifetime, rejects oversized output, uses an explicit final cleanup deadline, and reports cleanup uncertainty with the dedicated typed error before other failures.

Every destructive descendant test proves the descendant started first, path-with-spaces fixtures work, and the opt-in real-artifact test exercises digest/version/ROM plus production guarded gameplay spawn and cleanup.
Launcher tests, the opt-in real artifact test, strict launcher clippy, formatting, locked metadata, and diff checks pass; unclosable safe-Rust/platform limitations are reported exactly.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and verification outcomes are recorded.
A required correction cannot be implemented in safe Rust within owned_files without weakening containment or cleanup safety.
